events.text:
T-351 stays blocked until you unlock the Mac and turn on Accessibility for Python.app (tracked as T-403). The runner now reruns the preflight on every sweep and closes T-351 and starts T-132 by itself the moment it prints READY.

- **Preflight shows the binary macOS checks:** done in an earlier commit (ed632323). Rerun just now, it names Python.app (`/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/Resources/Python.app`) and prints NOT READY: Accessibility NO, Mac locked, Screen Recording yes, Claude window found.
- **Check on every sweep:** done in commit ab857476. I added `shots_gate` to `workshop-plan/tasks/runner.py`. It runs the preflight under the runner's own Python, so a READY from an interactive shell no longer counts. On READY it sets T-351 to done and sends T-132 a note to start `caffeinate` and the five captures. I tested it with a faked READY (it closed T-351 and sent the note), a faked NOT READY (nothing happened) and an already-done T-351 (nothing happened). Against the Mac's real state it did nothing, which is correct.
- **One ask for you:** T-132 has no ask of its own. T-402 asked the same thing as T-403, so I set it to dropped as a duplicate and T-403 is the only ask left.
- **Ripple note R-d0fc559f:** nothing more needed changing. The NOT READY result is already logged and T-351 is still blocked.
- **Notes:** F-97be9e13 and R-d0fc559f are acknowledged.
